verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe multi-language SDK support and show working code in Python (create_fts_index, to_pydantic), TypeScript (table.search().toArray(), arrow fields) and Rust (EmbeddingFunction impl, table.delete().await). Auth docs state API keys 'work in every SDK', and a community user reports shipping the npm package in an Electron app, though they criticize its confusing 'vectordb' package name and the documentation quality. Missing for 10: a dedicated SDK listing/API-reference page with versions and maturity per language, and stronger independent corroboration of SDK quality given the community complaints about naming and docs.
